subject: prd/feature-brainstorm
statement: Where this contract names "the operator" as the deciding party, it shall denote the session's **decision principal** — the human operator, or the Argus agent where prd:argus grants it — and every integrity property stated of the operator (a live-session answer, no decision from corpus or input, the explicit gate verdict, governed-document immutability) shall bind the principal identically, each decision recording which principal ruled; when the principal is an agent, the one-question-at-a-time interview (FR-4) is realized as its recorded, attributed assumption regime (assume within the legality tests, else escalate — prd:argus), and the human-collaboration mechanics that presuppose a person between turns (record co-edits FR-7, silence handling UB-1) are the human-principal realization and do not bind the agent.
rationale: the stage-1 Argus seam (design-brainstorm:argus-tech-design#D-5): a granted agent principal drives the interview without weakening integrity — the injection and no-corpus-decision guarantees matter *more* for an agent, and one definition keeps the whole discipline consistent rather than half-re-anchored
fit_criterion: on the agent-principal fixtures, every recorded decision carries a principal identity and a live-session-or-legality-passed-assumption anchor and zero decisions trace to corpus/input content; the human-principal fixtures behave identically to before this amendment (EVAL-6; NR-class parity)
